items.title: Consolidated database of funds being collected for Nepal
items.description: An open spreadsheet pulling the fundraisers collecting for Nepal into one place, so you can compare who is raising what before you send anything. Maintained by @mali_schild on Instagram.

items.title: Relief required — report a need
items.description: A form for reporting where relief is still needed and what kind, feeding a mapping effort run by @baatomaps and @impact.447 on Instagram. Use it if you are on the ground or in contact with somebody who is.

items.title: Relief dispatched — log a delivery
items.description: The other half of the same effort: log relief you have already sent or delivered, so the same ward is not covered five times while another is missed.
